limits: Synthetic verified identities and signed native stdio; no real Google, clean-machine, installed Mac or default-host approval proof.
A used chat remains pinned to its account; another account uses another chat.
Selecting an account pauses this chat capture; opt-in to syncing includes its existing visible turns. Existing archives stay in the original account.
Secondary profiles collect only explicitly assigned native chats, never all unassigned history. Regular web-only chat history is not collected.
Existing source exclusions, scoped conversations, private sharing gates and host permission decisions are preserved.
